text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Hatsune is roaming around town
looking for {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネは{0}を探して
ランドソルを歩き回っていた──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
There you are!
Hey! {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見～つけた！
おーい！　{0}くーん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Have you been hard at work? You just finishing up?
I see! Perfect timing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしてアルバイト中だった？　
今終わったところ？
そっか～、
ならちょうどよかったよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what kind of work were you doing?
Uh-huh, preparations for the Star Festival... Wait, what? You were
packing up 'cause it's been canceled? What the heck happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
一体なんのアルバイトをしてたの？
ふんふん、
星祭りの準備……
じゃなくて、
中止の片付け？
なんでなんで？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? The festival itself was canceled 'cause the annual meteor
shower that should be observable around now is nowhere to be seen?
Didn't think that was possible. Weird.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へー、
毎年この時期に観測できるはずの
流れ星がやって来ないから
お祭り自体が中止になっちゃったんだ。
そんなことってあるんだ。
不思議だね～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, wait a sec. Meteor?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………って、
あれ？　
星？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Um, that meteor wouldn't happen to be... the one that I destroyed,
would it...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えーとその星って、
もしかして……
こないだ私が壊した
隕石だったんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I-I knew it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やっぱりぃぃ～！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Urghhh... It's hard to believe that it's not related...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううー、
でも無関係とは思えないよぉ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
And everyone was so excited for the festival!
What should I do? I've really screwed things up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
お祭りを楽しみにしてたんだよね？
どうしよう、
私、悪いことしちゃったよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There wouldn't have been a festival anyway if Landosol
had been destroyed?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ランドソルが消えたら元も子もない？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Thanks, {0}.
I don't feel so bad about it now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん。
ありがと、{0}くん。
ちょっと気が楽になったよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: But I guess it's not good to overdo it with the superpowers, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
やっぱり超能力は
むやみに使っちゃダメだよね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, there's something troubling me.
I came to you hoping for some advice─
text_block_list.orig_text:
……実はね、
ちょっと困ったことがあって。
相談に乗ってもらおうかなって
思ってたんだけど──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*hic*
Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっく！
スヤァ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly thrown into the air, {0}
grabs a string that appears in front of him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
突然宙に投げ出された{0}は、
とっさに目の前に見えた紐を掴んだ──

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my balloon!
Thanks for getting it for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わああ、
あたしの風船！
とってくれてありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
You're really good at jumping!
It's almost like you were flying in the sky!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん、すごいジャンプりょくだね！
まるでお空を飛んでたみたい！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐ～、
スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why's this lady napping in the street?!
What a weirdo! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
このお姉ちゃん、
こんなところでお昼寝してる～！
へんなの～♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: *gasp* H-huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！　
あ、
あれ……？

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Morning, miss!
Why were you sleeping in a place like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
おはよう！　
お姉ちゃん。
どうしてこんなところでお昼寝してるの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Errr, beats me!
I just suddenly felt sleepy!
Ahahahahah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？　
えーっと、
なんでだろっ！
急に眠たくなっちゃって～
あはははは～！？

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you're so funny!
Mister, thanks for getting my balloon! Bye-bye! ♪
You too, miss, bye-bye! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
面白いお姉ちゃん！
お兄ちゃん、
風船ありがとう！　
ばいばーい♪
お姉ちゃんも、
ばいばい♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah!
Bye-bye! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん！
ばいばーい♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...Um, {0},
did I by any chance use my superpowers just now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えっと、{0}くん。
もしかして私、
超能力使っちゃってた？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you don't have to answer that!
*sigh*... I knew it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
返事くれなくても大丈夫！
ああ……
やっぱりかぁ～……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I've been feeling awful lately, or maybe I've been feeling too
good... I'm not really sure to be honest, but my superpowers have been
acting of their own accord.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね。
最近調子が悪いっていうか
よすぎるっていうか……
なんだかよく分かんないんだけど
超能力が勝手に出ちゃうんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: What's more, I instantly feel sleepy whenever it happens.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おまけに、
すぐに眠くなっちゃうし。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But I've started waking up pretty quickly...
I bet it's 'cause of all those things we tried!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもでも、
目が覚めるのは早くなってるんだよね……
そこはたぶん
キミといろいろ試したおかげだと思う！

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*...
I think I bought a little too much...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう、
ふう……
ちょっと
買いすぎちゃったかねえ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
That old lady over there's carrying too many bags.
I have to go help her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのおばあちゃんの荷物、
すっごい量だね。
お手伝いしてあげなくちゃ──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*hic*
Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっく！
スヤァ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Before he knows it, the woman's shopping bags
are in {0}'s hands.
text_block_list.orig_text: 荷物は、いつの間にか{0}の手の中にあった──

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Where are my things...? D-did somebody snatch them?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？
荷物が……
も、
もしかして
ひったくり──

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank goodness. You're just carrying them for me.
Sorry about that. You took me by surprise is all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
あらあら。
あなたが持ってくれてたのね。
ごめんなさいね、
いきなりだったから驚いてしまって。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ah! H-huh...?
Where's {0}...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！　
あ、
あれ……？
{0}くんは──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is he helping the old lady with her bags?
Hey, me too! Lemme lend a hand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
おばあちゃんの荷物を持ってあげてるの？
はいはーい！　
私もお手伝いするね！

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for carrying all this for me.
I don't know what I would've done without your kindness.
Take care, and have a lovely day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
運んでもらって
ありがとうね。
親切にしてもらって
本当に助かったわ。
それじゃあね、
ごきげんよう。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: See you, grandma!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーねー、
おばあちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh, I'm glad I could be useful...
H-huh? What's wrong? You look so tired.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
役に立ててよかったよ～……
って、
あ、
あれ？　
どうしたの？　
疲れた顔してるけど。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, ahahah...
I didn't by any chance use my superpowers without realizing again,
did I...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
あはは……
もしかして
さっきも私、
知らないうちに超能力使っちゃってたのかなぁ……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}...
Great, thanks...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……
うん、
ありがと……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Even though I cause you all sorts of trouble...
You're always so nice to me...
*sigh* But I shouldn't rely on you so much...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっぱい迷惑かけちゃってるのに……
{0}くんって、
本当に優しいな……
うう、
でも
甘えちゃ悪いよね……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'd best get going now!
I'll just end up causing you more trouble if I stay...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
それじゃあ私、
そろそろ行くね！
これ以上キミと一緒にいたら、
もっと迷惑かけちゃうし……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Really...? Even though I'm being such a nuisance...!
I'm so happy...! H─
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミ……
私、
こんなに迷惑かけてるのに……！
うれしいよぉ～……
ひっ──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*hic*
Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっく！
スヤァ……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what should I make for lunch today...?
Uwaaaaghhh! Pervert!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて
今日のお昼ご飯は何にしようかしら……
って、
きゃあああっ！　
へんたい～～～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Don't look around as if you don't know it's YOU I'm talking about!
Why've you got no clothes on in the middle of the street?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何キョロキョロしてるの！
あなたよ、
あなた！　
街中でなんで服を脱いでるの！？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Th-this is public indecency!
Y-you should be ashamed of yourself...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっ、
公衆の面前で、
そ、
そんな格好になるなんて……！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? I heard a scream... Eh?
You, boy! What're you doing?! Put that thing away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだなんだ？　
今、
悲鳴が……
って、
兄ちゃん、
そんな格好で何やってんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: He's clearly up to no good...!
text_block_list.orig_text: こいつぁ事件の匂いがするぜ……！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Not what I think...?
Exactly what am I misunderstanding about this situation?
Explain yourself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誤解だって……？
その状況のどこが誤解だってんだ！　
説明してみろよ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
What?
You were seeing to that girl after she collapsed on the side of the road?
Then why are you like that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
道端で倒れてたその子を
介抱しようとしてたの？
なぜそんな格好で……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess you don't seem like such a bad guy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもまぁ、
兄ちゃん悪いことしそうな奴にゃあ
見えねぇよなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
You're right... He does have quite a friendly face.
Even though there's barely a lick of clothing on him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうねぇ……
人のよさそうな顔してるものね。
半裸なのはともかく……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Zzz...
{0}... Stop it, you shouldn't touch me there...! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
スヤスヤ……
{0}くん……
ダメだよぉ、
そんなとこ触っちゃあ……♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Someone, heeeelp!
text_block_list.orig_text: 誰かーーーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Ah! He's getting away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
逃げたぞ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Stop right there!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ちなさーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Zzz... Tee hee... Being carried bridal style...
It's like a dreeeam...! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
むにゃ、
えへへ……
お姫さま抱っこ……
夢みた～い……♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Mmn...
*gasp* I didn't do it again, did I?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぁ～……
むにゅ……
はっ！　
もしかして私、
またやっちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? {0}, why aren't you wearing any clothes?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
どうして{0}くん、
服を脱いでるの！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Uh, d-don't tell me...
while I was asleep, you were...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
もっ、
もしかして……
私が寝てる間に……！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
My superpowers made your clothes... disappear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
超能力で、
服が……
消えた？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: F-forgive meeeee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご……
ごめ～～～んっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my god, I'm so sorry.
All I do is cause you trouble...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当にごめんね。
なんだか迷惑かけっぱなしで……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I know you told me you don't mind, but this is just...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは
気にしないって言ってくれたけど、
やっぱり
こんなの……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...Fun?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……楽しい？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
It's fun 'cause it's impossible to predict what'll happen...?
I see. Well, if you put it that way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何が起きるか分からなくて、
楽しいって……
そっか。
そんな風に、
言ってくれるんだ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm having fun too.
Every time I wake up, your face is so close to mine...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
私も楽しいよ。
目が覚めたら、
いつも{0}くんの顔が
近くにあって……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean!
You must be cold, so let's go find your clothes!
Ah, do you wanna wear mine?! I'm just messin' with ya, eheheh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
えっと！　
とりあえず、
{0}くんの服を探しに行かなくちゃ！
あ、
私の服着る！？　
それは無理だよね、
えへへっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
All righty then, I'll find your clothes!
It's about time I showed you how helpful my superpowers really are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぉっし、
キミの服は私が見つけてみせるよ！
ハツネちゃんの超能力が役に立つってところ、
{0}くんに見せちゃうんだから！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry!
We wouldn't want you to get sick now, would we?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
急ごう！
{0}くんが
風邪ひいちゃったら大変だもん！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And so, with a smile on her face,
Hatsune returned to the city with {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
笑顔になったハツネと一緒に、
{0}は街へと戻るのであった。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. What are these clothes doing on the ground?
...I wonder who they belong to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
こんなところに服が落ちてるわ。
……誰のかしら？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Let's take them to the lost and found at the guard station.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず、
詰め所にでも届けておいてやるか。
